description: This file implements a command-line tool in Rust called `append_squashfs_overlay`. The tool generates a new SquashFS image by overlaying one image onto another, with options to overwrite existing files. It includes functions to handle file merging, size alignment, and command-line argument parsing, along with unit tests. The file offers utility functions and command definitions specific to its purpose within a larger project.
external_files: std::io::{copy, Error, ErrorKind, Read, Result, Seek, SeekFrom}

methods.name: merge_fs(src: &Path, overlay: &Path, dest: &Path, overwrite: bool) -> Result<()>
methods.description: Merges a source SquashFS image with an overlay image into a destination file, supporting optional overwrite.

methods.name: align_size(size: u64, alignment: u64) -> u64
methods.description: Aligns a given size up to the specified power-of-two alignment.

methods.name: clap_command() -> Command
methods.description: Defines and configures the command-line argument parser for the tool.

methods.name: main() -> Result<()>
methods.description: Entry point of the tool; parses arguments and initiates the merging process.
